chapters.label: The goal, live
chapters.text: Düsseldorf, Euro 2024. England are losing to Switzerland, with ten minutes left. The ball comes to Bukayo Saka on the right. He faces up his defender... cuts inside... shoots... one-one!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. Saka runs straight at the defender and makes him stop. Then he drives inside, and suddenly the goal opens up.

chapters.label: Into the corner
chapters.text: He shoots low, across the keeper, into the far corner. Yann Sommer can't reach it. Five minutes after Switzerland scored, it's one-one!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: face up your defender, then drive inside to open up the shot.
